blocks.x: Which unfortunately hit on the worst possible time to exist.
Yep, it was a good time for music but a lousy time for bands.

Yeah, it was really the end of the big band era, if it wasn’t for Basie, Ellington and some Woody bands and some Kenton bands, the big band era was over. Elliot’s band was never really a band, it just had a lot of talent in it for a while, but it was a high-grade New York pickup band. That's all it was.
